skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Routes video edit requests to the appropriate RunComfy model for restyling, background changes, packaging replacement, motion transfer, and outfit edits. It documents required inputs, prompt guidance, CLI commands, limits, and privacy notes for Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control, and Lucy Edit Restyle.
skill.summary: Route video edit requests to the best RunComfy model and prepare model-specific prompts.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, placeholder URLs, and a documented token path. No prompt injection text, covert exfiltration, or malicious instructions were found in SKILL.md. The skill still depends on the RunComfy CLI and third-party media processing, so users should approve external processing before use.

remediation.issue: RunComfy CLI commands may be executed by an agent or user.
remediation.suggestion: State that installs, login, and run commands require explicit user approval before execution.

remediation.issue: User-provided media URLs are processed by RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short consent reminder before submitting private, regulated, or customer-owned videos.

remediation.issue: The token storage note references a hidden configuration path.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the 0600 permission guidance and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI environments.

content.user_title: Edit Videos with RunComfy Model Routing
content.value_statement: Choosing the right video edit model is hard when each route has different strengths. This skill routes the request and prepares prompts for RunComfy video editing models.
actual_capabilities: Routes restyle, background swap, packaging swap, motion transfer, and outfit requests to documented RunComfy models.
Maps default restyle and packaging edits to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Maps motion reference requests to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Maps lightweight outfit and identity-stable restyle requests to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides model fields, prompt patterns, output limits, exit codes, and privacy notes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, account access, and either login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
Requires source media to be available through URLs accepted by the selected model.
Does not blend multiple RunComfy routes in one request.
Cannot remove each model duration, resolution, aspect ratio, or audio limits.

use_cases.title: Restyle Short Clips
use_cases.description: Creators can preserve a subject motion while changing lighting, background, or visual style.

use_cases.title: Update Product Footage
use_cases.description: Marketing teams can replace packaging designs or backgrounds while keeping the original camera movement.

use_cases.title: Transfer Reference Motion
use_cases.description: Animators can map motion from a reference video onto a target character with identity preservation.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video with RunComfy: [video URL]. Preserve the subject face and motion. Change the setting to [new setting].

prompt_templates.title: Swap a Product Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the best RunComfy route for this product video: [video URL]. Keep camera motion. Replace the background with [background description].

prompt_templates.title: Apply Reference Packaging
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this product clip: [video URL]. Use this reference image for the new packaging: [image URL]. Preserve framing and hand movement.

prompt_templates.title: Transfer Motion to a Character
prompt_templates.prompt: Use RunComfy motion control. Transfer motion from [reference video URL] to the character in [image or video URL]. Keep identity stable and preserve sound if useful.

output_examples.input: Edit a talking-head clip so it looks like a modern office, but keep the voice and lip movement.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan 2.7 Edit-Video. The prompt starts with face, pose, lip movement, and audio preservation before describing the office background.

output_examples.input: Make the character in my image dance like the reference clip.
output_examples.output: Selected Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control. The output plan uses the reference clip for motion and the image for identity.

output_examples.input: Change a walking subject into professional business attire.
output_examples.output: Selected Lucy Edit Restyle. The prompt requests a localized outfit change and preserves face and motion.

best_practices: Start prompts with what must be preserved, then state one edit direction.
Use reference images only when the edit needs direct visual transfer.
Confirm user consent before sending private media URLs to RunComfy.
anti_patterns: Do not combine restyle, packaging replacement, and motion transfer in one call.
Do not use Lucy Edit Restyle when the request needs 1080p output or aspect control.
Do not pass sensitive media URLs without clear approval from the user.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes video edit requests to RunComfy models and prepares model-specific prompts.

faq.question: Which models can it choose?
faq.answer: It covers Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control, and Lucy Edit Restyle.

faq.question: Does it edit videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit jobs to RunComfy services.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Most routes require a video URL, an edit prompt, and sometimes a reference image or motion video.

faq.question: Can it preserve audio?
faq.answer: Some routes support audio preservation. The skill documents when to use origin audio or original sound options.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private videos?
faq.answer: Use care. User-provided media URLs are processed by RunComfy, so private content needs explicit approval.
